verification.validation: The full SDK release gate covers all Go modules and language SDKs, oldest supported Python/Node runtimes, three Go/Rust architectures and warm/cold reproducible executor builds. Supplemental aarch64/armv7 QEMU checks cover native account decoding, shared deadlines and NOFILE policy. Publication requires the recorded gate and private-policy content/diff/artifact scans to pass on this release candidate. Crates publication and live NAS acceptance are excluded.

daemonNoFile.reason: daemonctl is a per-App controller built from SDK source; it is not a protected executor/lifecycle binary or an imported dependency of either protected build.

changes: Use the shared five-minute operation default and tolerant startup; live root jobs have no total elapsed cap.
Expose complete native local/domain account snapshots, numeric group IDs, verified source and distinct not-found/timeout/unavailable errors.
Retain conservative expiry admission and refuse unverified LDAP status; native account lookups preserve explicit caller deadlines and cancellation.
Ship the rebuilt native account bridges and refreshed protected executor inventory.
Support non-root daemon NOFILE inheritance, bounded configuration and fail-closed inherited hard ceilings; preserve low-limit lifecycle control.
